instruction_bn: বন্ধু/আত্মীয়কে একটি informal letter/email লেখো। নিজে লেখার পর নমুনা ও checklist দেখো (Board: 10 marks)।

items.prompt: Write a letter to your friend describing your first day at college.
items.model:
Dhaka
10 July 2026

Dear Rahat,
Take my love. In this letter I want to tell you about my first day at college.

On the first day I felt both happy and nervous. I put on a neat dress and reached the college early. Everything looked new and big to me. At first I could not find my classroom, but a senior student kindly showed me the way. In the class the teachers welcomed us with a smile and gave us good advice. I made a few new friends there. The teachers also told us about the rules of the college. The day passed very quickly and pleasantly. I came back home with a happy mind.

I shall never forget this memorable day. Convey my regards to your parents.

Your loving friend,
Mahin
rubric: 'Your loving friend' + নাম দিয়ে শেষ করেছি

items.prompt: Write a letter to your friend describing a road accident you witnessed.
items.model:
Dhaka
10 May 2026

Dear Sabbir,
Take my love. In this letter I want to tell you about a terrible road accident which I saw yesterday.

Yesterday afternoon I was returning home from college. Near the market a bus was running at a great speed. Suddenly it lost control and hit a rickshaw. The rickshaw broke into pieces, and the passenger fell down and was badly injured. People rushed to the spot and took the injured man to the hospital. The bus driver ran away, leaving the bus. Such accidents happen mostly for reckless driving. It was really a heart-breaking scene.

We should be more careful on the road. Convey my regards to your parents.

Your loving friend,
Joy
rubric: 'Your loving friend' + নাম দিয়ে শেষ করেছি

items.prompt: Write a letter to your friend advising him to be honest in life.
items.model:

Dear Rtd,
Take my love. I am writing this letter to give you some advice about honesty, as I care for you as a true friend.

Honesty is a great virtue. An honest man is respected and trusted by all. He never tells a lie or does any wrong. Though a dishonest man may prosper for a while, he can never be happy in the long run. Honesty brings peace of mind and real success in life. So, always speak the truth and be honest in all your dealings. Remember, honesty is the best policy.

I hope you will follow my advice. Convey my regards to your parents.

Your loving friend,

items.prompt: Write a letter to your friend about the importance of tree plantation.
items.model:
Dhaka
10 May 2026

Dear Rasel,
Take my love. In this letter I want to write to you about the importance of tree plantation.

Trees are our best friends. They give us oxygen, food, fruits, wood and shade. They save us from floods, keep the soil firm and cause rainfall. They also keep the air fresh and cool. But some greedy people are cutting down trees carelessly. If we do not plant new trees, our country will one day turn into a desert. So, we should plant more and more trees around our houses, schools and roads.

Let us plant at least one tree this rainy season. Convey my regards to your parents.

Your loving friend,
Tamim

items.model:

Dear Rakib,
Take my love. In this letter I want to tell you about a terrible cyclone that hit our area last week.

One evening the sky suddenly became dark. Then a violent storm began to blow with a great roar. It uprooted many trees and blew away the roofs of many houses. Heavy rain followed the storm. The cyclone continued for about an hour. When it stopped, we came out and saw the terrible destruction. Many houses were damaged, and the standing crops were ruined. Some people were also injured. The people of our area passed a night of great fear and suffering.

Such natural calamities cause us great harm. Convey my regards to your parents.

Your loving friend,

items.prompt: Write a letter to your friend describing how you observed 21st February.

Dear Rimon,
Take my love. In this letter I want to tell you how I observed the 21st of February, our International Mother Language Day.

On that day I got up early in the morning. I put on a white dress and, with my friends, walked barefoot to the Shaheed Minar singing 'Amar Bhaiyer Rakte Rangano'. We placed a wreath of flowers at the Shaheed Minar to show respect to the language martyrs. Then we attended a discussion meeting held in our college. Learned speakers spoke about the great sacrifice of Salam, Barkat, Rafiq and Jabbar. In the afternoon there was a cultural programme. The day filled my heart with respect for the martyrs.

We should always honour our mother tongue. Convey my regards to your parents.

Your loving friend,
Saad
